options.title: OPTIONS
options.hint: up/down = choose | tap = change | right = back
options.hint.category: up/down = choose | tap = open | right = back
opt.downscroll.desc: Notes scroll from top to bottom and the HUD flips.
opt.ghostTapping.desc: Tapping with no note nearby does not count as a miss.
opt.splashes.desc: Shows a splash when you hit a SICK note.
opt.camZooming.desc: The camera pulses to the beat.
opt.antialiasing.desc: Smooths sprites. Turn off for more performance.
opt.lowQuality.desc: Hides the stage background objects and splashes.
opt.fpsCounter.desc: Shows the FPS in the corner of the screen.
opt.flashing.desc: Off = slower flickers and no magenta flash.
opt.menuLog.desc: Shows the mod log for 3 seconds on the main menu.
opt.hitbox.desc: Flashes the 4 touch lanes while playing.
opt.touchCursor.desc: Shows a cursor and the gesture name in the menus.
mods.hint:
up/down = choose | tap selected = apply
right = back | left = reload list
opt.shaders.desc: Enables shader effects from mods. Turn off for more performance.
opt.updCheck.desc: Asks GitHub if there is a newer commit than this build.
opt.updGithub.desc: Opens this build's commit (or the repository) in the browser.
upd.status.ahead: this build is ahead of GitHub
upd.status.unknown: this build's commit was not found on GitHub
